sn11.19:1.2: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Mātalisaṅgāhakam āmantesi || ||
sn11.19:1.3: Yojehi samma Mātali sahassayuttam ājaññarathaṃ || uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyā ti || || 3.
sn11.19:1.4: Evam bhadanta vā ti kho bhikkhave Mātali-saṅgāhako Sakkassa devānam indassa paṭissutvā sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā Sakkassa devānam indassa paṭivedesi || ||
sn11.19:1.5: Yutto kho te mārisa sahassayutto ājaññaratho
sn11.19:1.7: Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Vejayantapāsādā orohanto pañjaliko sudam Bhagavantaṃ namassati || || 5.
sn11.19:1.8: Atha kho bhikkhave Mātali-saṅgāhako Sakkaṃ devānam indaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || || 6.
